title: Understanding Bias in Models
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, think about how it might help the model capture more complex patterns in the data. This can potentially reduce the error due to bias.

title: Effect of Adding Features on Bias
text: Consider how adding a feature that is the square of an existing feature might affect the model's ability to fit the data. Does it make the model more flexible or less flexible?
